title: Print Abbreviation Mechanism
description: Add a proper abbreviation-list mechanism (Abkürzungsverzeichnis) to the print LaTeX stack, generalizing the existing glossary machinery (GlossaryDefine/Gls/listofglossaries in print/tex/semio-window.sty, semio-table.sty, semio-core.sty) into a shared term-list factory instantiated for both glossary and abbreviations. Remove the dead/colliding `abbreviations` window-kind (box type, never used, squats on \listofabbreviations name). Wire it into mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex (and its -dark sibling) in the appendix directly after \listofglossaries, with entries for LLM, KI, AP, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR (German, no-technical-background definitions), and \Abbr{} wired at each term's first occurrence in the body so page references populate.
summary: Follow-up to the abbreviation-list feature: changed `\AbbreviationDefine` from a 2-arg (abbr, combined-text) to a 3-arg signature (abbr, expansion, explanation), e.g. `\AbbreviationDefine{BBSR}{Bundesinstitut für Bau-, Stadt- und Raumforschung}{Die Bundesbehörde, die dieses Forschungsvorhaben fördert.}`. Implemented as a bespoke override in semio-window.sty (`\cs_set_protected:Npn \AbbreviationDefine #1#2#3`) sitting on top of the shared termlist engine's `\semio_termlist_define:nnn`, joining expansion and explanation as "Expansion -- Explanation" for the existing single Bedeutung column — `\GlossaryDefine` and the rest of the shared engine are untouched. Updated all 8 call sites in zwischenbericht.tex and its -dark sibling to the new 3-arg form, and the ticket's verify-abbreviations.tex fixture. Rebuilt and visually verified via PNG render.
